newsitem.title: USA: CMC Industries sees Q4 earnings below Q3.
newsitem.headline: CMC Industries sees Q4 earnings below Q3.

text.p: CMC Industries Inc said Friday it expects earnings for its fourth quarter will be below its third quarter when it had net income of $550,000, or $0.08 a share.

Analysts had expected the company would earn $0.09 a share in its fourth quarter, according to First Call. In the comparable year-ago period CMC had profits of $480,000, or $0.07 a share, on revenues of $41.4 million.

The company said revenues for the fourth quarter, ending July 31, will exceed third quarter levels of $54.4 million. The company said it results would be hurt by delays in volume production of certain of its new customers.

CMC said that, despite the higher revenues, earnings would be lower that third quarter levels because of the cost of investments made to increase capacity and capabilities at the company's California operations. The company said it will take a one time charge of less than $1 million in the fourth quarter to write off inventory balances.
